defects_observed_live: Horizon pill (16% height, radius height/2, horizontal gradient) drew a hard top line and visible gradient columns across the bottom content row on every page.
Library and Home tiles: ColumnLayout spread spare cell height between icon and name; a wrapped name lifted only its own icon, so a row had several icon levels.
Home and Customize cut their last row in half at the viewport edge with no sign that content continued.
Customize: the native Plasma off-switch groove vanished on the setting card's ink tint and read as a radio ring next to an on switch.
Portrait/tablet Home: the stretched section column shared spare viewport height as gaps, leaving ~106px of empty glass between 'Pinned' and its first row (also present in the 165 matrix captures).

repairs.horizon: Vertical rim glow inside the glass sheet, transparent top stop, highlight .075 dark/.045 light at the rim; no edge, no banding.
repairs.tiles: Icon and name travel as one group between two fillers over a reserved two-line name (shared FontMetrics, top-aligned).
repairs.hover: Control Center glass card: .14 accent tint, .32 accent hairline, white top sheen; focus keeps its .82 two-pixel edge.
repairs.scroll_edge: Viewport-owned gradient into the glass surface colour, visible only while content continues below; no input, no layer or shader.
repairs.switch: Ink track under the native PC3.Switch indicator, hidden when checked so the native accent groove remains the owner.
repairs.home_packing: A trailing fill item takes spare height below the sections; the native driver refuses a heading-to-first-row gap above two spacing steps (old 106px fails).

native_controls.driver_assertions: Row icon level <=1px, name gap <= space2, name ink inside card, scroll edge parented to viewport and visible exactly while Home overflows, rimless vertical horizon, switch track equals native indicator geometry and hides when checked.
native_controls.old_layout_negative: Removing the fillers/reservation fails the native driver: 'name sits with its icon: gap=41'; fixed source passes 9/9 launcher tests. Removing the Home tail filler fails 'first pinned row follows its heading: gap=106'.
native_controls.matrix: 36 native popup cases, 18 palettes x Arabic/English, passed on frozen 68cbdc46 before the Home packing fix; rerun on the final frozen commit is recorded in the PR.

live.selection: select-live-launcher.py verified Codex inventory bytes exactly, archived them as retired-live-package-033f6448 and installed this package; --retire restores the Codex copy. Not a signed OS update.
live.journeys: Guarded entry click opened Mova; Customize shows the visible off track; Library rows share one icon level with names beneath; Home fades the workspace row below the fold; pointer hover shows the glass card. Escape closed only after the launcher was confirmed active. Shell journal: no launcher or QML errors.

release_blocker: Main x86 signed build 44157887989 for dbdfdd66 refused at the high npm audit gate: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (picomatch ReDoS) was widened on 2026-11-17 to <=4.0.7 with no patched release; picomatch reaches the controller only through vite/workbox build tooling. The gate stays unchanged; a patched upstream release is required before the next signed candidate.
remaining: Signed immutable delivery of launcher, Control Center and moos-control after the upstream picomatch fix.
Physical touch, portrait/tablet and assistive-technology journeys.
